overview.description: The Yorkville America Next Generation Memory Index ETF (NRAM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is a passively managed fund that tracks a market cap-weighted index of companies with business activities associated with the design, development, manufacturing and supply of physical memory, including advanced semiconductor memory technologies. NRAM was launched on Sep 10, 2026 and is issued by Yorkville.
